Container.Name: RaveBot
Container.Overview: Discord bot that automates DJ booking for recurring online raves: DJ onboarding by DM, self-service slot booking, automatic invites for open slots, a lineup post in your DJ channel and an admin log. Events, slots and DJs live in Notion databases the bot creates itself. Needs a PostgreSQL 16 database, a Discord bot token and a Notion integration. After the first start, run /setup in your Discord server.
Container.Requires: A PostgreSQL 16 database (for example the PostgreSQL 16 container from Community Applications).

Config.Name: Discord bot token
Config.Description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal (Bot, Reset Token).

Config.Name: PostgreSQL URL
Config.Description: Connection string of the database. Use the IP address of your Unraid server, not localhost.

Config.Name: Notion API key
Config.Description: Internal Integration Secret of your Notion integration.

Config.Name: Notion parent page ID
Config.Description: 32 character ID of an empty Notion page that is shared with the integration. The bot creates its databases under it.

Config.Name: Admin user IDs
Config.Description: Comma separated Discord user IDs of the owners. They can always use the admin commands.

Config.Name: Admin page password
Config.Description: Optional. Password of the admin page (add and remove admins in the browser). Leave empty to turn the page off. Use a long random value.

Config.Name: Admin page port
Config.Description: Optional. Port of the admin page. Only used when a password is set. Local network only, never expose it to the internet.
